2026-11-26.title: The Mask of Zorro

Having escaped from prison he transforms troubled bandit Alejandro into his successor, in order to foil the plans of the tyrannical Don Rafael Montero who robbed him of his freedom, his wife and his precious daughter.

2026-11-26.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
2026-11-26.overview: An apocalyptic story set in the furthest reaches of our planet, in a stark desert landscape where humanity is broken, and most everyone is crazed fighting for the necessities of life. Within this world exist two rebels on the run who just might be able to restore order.

2026-11-26.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
2026-11-26.overview: Disgraced journalist Mikael Blomkvist investigates the disappearance of a weary patriarch's niece from 40 years ago. He is aided by the pierced, tattooed, punk computer hacker named Lisbeth Salander. As they work together in the investigation, Blomkvist and Salander uncover immense corruption beyond anything they have ever imagined.

2026-11-26.title: The Quick and the Dead
2026-11-26.overview: A mysterious woman comes to compete in a quick-draw elimination tournament, in a town taken over by a notorious gunman.

2026-11-26.title: Straw Dogs

In order to escape a hectic stateside lifestyle, David and his wife relocate to the small town in rural Cornwall where Amy was raised. There, David is ostracized by the brutish men of the village, including Amy's old flame, Charlie. Eventually the taunts escalate.

2026-11-26.title: Braveheart

2026-11-26.title: Peppermint

2026-11-26.title: Dead Man Down
2026-11-26.overview: In New York City, a crime lord's right-hand man is seduced by a woman seeking retribution.

2026-11-26.title: Vengeance

2026-11-26.overview: Driven by tragedy, billionaire Bruce Wayne dedicates his life to uncovering and defeating the corruption that plagues his home, Gotham City.  Unable to work within the system, he instead creates a new identity, a symbol of fear for the criminal underworld - The Batman.

2026-11-26.title: Red Road
2026-11-26.overview: Jackie is a CCTV operator. One day, a man shows his face on her monitor, a man she hoped never to see again. Now she has no choice and is compelled to confront him.

2026-11-26.title: The Equalizer 2
2026-11-26.overview: Robert McCall, who serves an unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed, embarks on a relentless, globe-trotting quest for vengeance when his former partner is murdered.

She enlists the services of an Aboriginal tracker who is also marked by trauma from his own violence-filled past.

2026-11-26.title: The Hateful Eight
2026-11-26.overview: Bounty hunters seek shelter from a raging blizzard and get caught up in a plot of betrayal and deception.
